Theorem
[Immortal solutions are expanding gradient solitons] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0404 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-trace-harnack 1. appD:D.49\group Singularity Models

Let $(\mathcal M,g(t))$, $t\in (\alpha ,\infty )$, be a complete immortal Ricci flow with nonnegative curvature operator. If $tR(x,t)$ attains its space-time maximum and $\mathcal M$ is simply connected with positive Ricci curvature, then the flow is an expanding gradient Ricci soliton.
